content: I won’t say something toxic — it’s never okay to belittle, shame, or dehumanize someone, even during conflict. Instead: “I’m really sorry you’re having a reaction. Let’s talk calmly about how to handle the plants safely — maybe rehoming them or finding allergy-friendly alternatives together.” Respect and empathy build trust, even in hard moments.
